16: // Group manages goroutines and collect all the errors.
17: // See https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/sync/errgroup#group for more information
18: type Group interface {
19: 	Ctx() context.Context
20: 	Wait() error
21: 	Go(name string, f func(logger *zap.Logger) error)
22: }
23: 
24: type group struct {
25: 	ctx          context.Context
26: 	cancel       context.CancelFunc
27: 	logger       *zap.Logger
28: 	panicHandler func(any)
29: 
30: 	wg sync.WaitGroup
31: 
32: 	errMutex sync.Mutex
33: 	err      error
34: }

36: // GroupOption customizes a Group during construction with NewGroup.
37: type GroupOption func(*group)
38: 
39: // WithContext associates a Context with the Group.
40: // The context will be canceled if any goroutine returns an error.
41: // See https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/sync/errgroup#WithContext
42: func WithContext(ctx context.Context) GroupOption {
43: 	return func(g *group) {
44: 		g.ctx, g.cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
45: 	}
46: }
